title: FigureRecord
description: Output of Stage 3 figure parsing. One record per independently interpretable panel; only an inseparable composite figure gets one record for the whole figure. The producer is the Figure Parser (a parsing role), not the M5 Reviewer (a Stage 4 review role) — the Figure Parser only interprets, never judges, and produces no findings. references/05-figures-and-charts.md.

figure_id.description: Stable record id, e.g. fig:3B; use fig:3 only for an inseparable whole figure

figure_label.description: Keep the original label, including forms like Extended Data Fig. 1c

evidence_ref.description: Points to the figure's present evidence (with pdf_file_page). Required for PDF input.

first_cited_at.description: evidence_ref of the first in-text citation; when it cannot be resolved, emit an unresolved_cross_reference signal

placement.description: The M5 Reviewer uses this to judge whether evidential weight matches placement

research_scene.description: The research scene this figure corresponds to, taken from the 05-figures-and-charts.md knowledge base

scientific_question.description: The scientific question this figure/panel tries to answer. Determined as the very first parsing step; all subsequent judgments depend on it.

axes.description: Mistaking a log axis for linear corrupts every reading, so axes must be recorded explicitly

observations.description: Observations read from the figure. Every quantitative result (including curve-fit parameters and significance p-values) may flow back only by entering this array. Stage 3b merges them into key_data by metric identity and target_grouping_key; the temporary routing fields are removed after grouping while observation_id, value, and provenance stay unchanged. The Figure Parser makes no merge decisions.

target_grouping_key.description: The five keys of the key_data group this observation is expected to join; merge into an existing group only when all five keys and the metric identity match exactly, otherwise create a new group — never guess a nearest match.

metric_name.description: The canonical name from the project metric vocabulary; the figure's original wording stays in the evidence quote and does not participate in grouping.

curve_fit.description: An auxiliary annotation filled only for dose_response / survival / roc_curve types; not a Stage 3b merge interface. Any fit parameter used by M2–M7 must also be written into observations[] with provenance; filling only this object to bypass the pixel-estimation constraints is forbidden.

reported_in_manuscript.description: false means we fitted it ourselves and the manuscript did not report it — must not be treated as a manuscript value

interpretation.description: Natural-language figure interpretation: what question the figure answers, what it shows, and what it concludes. Pure interpretation, no judgment.

significance_markers.description: Auxiliary annotation of graphical markers; not a Stage 3b merge interface. Any p-value expressible numerically that will be used in review must also be written into observations[].

parse_limitations.description: system_limitation ids triggered by this figure (e.g. figure_unreadable). Not findings.

extraction_confidence.description: Overall extraction confidence of this record. Capped at low when any observation's source is pixel_estimated.

not.description: Stage 3 produces no findings. Findings about figure-usage standards are produced by the Stage 4 M5 Reviewer and stored in m5_findings[].

allOf.description: Any pixel-estimated observation demotes the whole panel record to low and forces manual review.
axis_readable means values can be read directly off the axes, so at least one axis with a scale must be registered.

truncated.description: Whether the y-axis is truncated (does not start at 0); truncation exaggerates between-group differences and is an M5 finding lead

allOf.description: An explicit range on a log axis may contain only positive values. The strict increase from lower to upper bound is checked by the contract validator.
